sentences.en: The curtain fell amid the wild applause of the audience.
sentences.zh: 1. 帷幕在观众狂热的掌声中落下。

sentences.en: She was standing amid the ruins of the castle.
Their house lay amid a small stand of trees.
sentences.zh: 3. 他们的房子位于一片小树林中间。
